title: The back page, 2017
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: Friday. The Timberline comes out. Wood reads the back page at Gully's. The kid's strip. The strip shows Wood reading it and shows the reader nothing of it. Gully reads it over his shoulder and laughs, once, at something we don't see.

panels.composition: Gully's. WOOD on the end stool with a school paper folded to the back page. GULLY behind him. BARNABY II.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a graying man on a shop stool reading a school newspaper's back page with a stocky man reading over his shoulder, a small three-legged dog beneath

panels.composition: The back page from behind: the newsprint, the light through it, a four-panel shape. Unreadable. The kid's strip, as a silhouette.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, close-up of a newspaper page seen from behind with light through it showing the silhouette of a four-panel comic strip, unreadable
image.notes: The kid's strip is never shown. Reserved.

panels.composition: Gully laughing. Once. Short. Wood looking up at him.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a stocky man giving one short laugh while a graying man looks up at him from a newspaper

panels.composition: Wood folding the paper. Putting it in the chore coat's pocket, the deep one. The pup. Gully pouring. Twenty years and one week.

characters.pose: folding the paper into his pocket

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a graying man folding a school newspaper into the deep pocket of his chore coat while a stocky man pours coffee and a small dog watches, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: 'Panel three.' The kid's strip, a silhouette. Into the deep pocket.
